EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERALGovernment Notifications
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, by virtue of the powers vested inme by Section 4 of the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393) do hereby enlarge the Six Month period of time ending31st July 2018 by five months from 31st July 2018 up to 31st December 2018 for the rendering of the final report oncompletion of the said tasks of the Commission of Inquiry established on 31 st January 2018 by Notification publishedin the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2056/41 dated 02nd February 2018 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lankain terms of the provisions of Section 2 of the aforesaid Act to investigate into alleged irregularities in connection withSri Lankan Airlines Limited, Sri Lanka Catering Limited and Mihin Lanka (Private) Limited during the period 01st January,2006 to 31st January, 2018.
